# Getting Support

The GitHub issue tracker is for **bug reports and feature requests** only. For general help and questions, please use one of the channels below.

## Documentation

Start here — the answer you're looking for is probably documented:

- **[Official Documentation](https://fetch-php.thavarshan.com)** — Installation, guides, configuration reference
- **[API Reference](https://fetch-php.thavarshan.com/api/)** — Full class and method documentation
- **[Changelog](https://github.com/Thavarshan/fetch-php/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)** — What's new in each release

## Community

- **[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/Thavarshan/fetch-php/discussions)** — Ask questions, share ideas, show what you've built, discuss best practices

## Reporting Bugs

Before opening an issue, please:

1. Search [existing issues](https://github.com/Thavarshan/fetch-php/issues) to avoid duplicates
2. Confirm you're running a [supported PHP version](https://github.com/Thavarshan/fetch-php#requirements) (PHP 8.3+)
3. Include a minimal reproducible example

Use the [bug report template](https://github.com/Thavarshan/fetch-php/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) to open a new issue.

## Security Vulnerabilities

**Do not open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Please report them privately through [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/Thavarshan/fetch-php/security/advisories/new). See [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Thavarshan/fetch-php/blob/main/SECURITY.md) for the full disclosure policy.

## Private Contact

For sensitive matters that don't fit the above channels, reach the maintainer at [tjthavarshan@gmail.com](mailto:tjthavarshan@gmail.com).
